offering_description.value: Sells pre-show and on-screen advertising across a network of movie theaters, reaching moviegoers before films. It also distributes live and recorded alternative content events to theaters and shares ad revenue with theater exhibitor partners.

primary_products.value: on-screen cinema advertising; lobby and digital place-based displays; alternative content events

primary_services.value: advertising sales and campaign management; event distribution to cinemas; audience measurement and reporting

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, advertising agencies, movie studios, event promoters

revenue_model.value: advertising: advertisers pay for screen time and placements in theaters; service fees: event producers and promoters pay to distribute content to theaters

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells and operates advertising across partner theaters, paying exhibitors a share of revenue, sold to advertisers and agencies; distributor: distributes live and recorded events to cinemas, taking in event fees, sold to event producers and promoters

geography_served.value: US national: Network of theaters across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: cinema advertising, digital place-based media, and alternative content events sharing theater audiences and channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to national and local advertisers and agencies; partners / resellers: theater exhibitor partners hosting screens and displays

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules and advertising standards, no special industry license required
